original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团在大通季地区持续巡逻以保护平民、缓解紧张局势
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹大通季地区族群间暴力再度爆发，瓦拉普州通季北县阿科普乡等地民居被烧、民众流离失所。联合国南苏丹特派团综合巡逻队前往阿科普及本迪尔村，安抚受影响居民并评估紧急需求。据救济与恢复委员会称，通季北县逾1.2万户家庭据报流离失所，该委员会于10月28日发出紧急援助呼吁。

location.site: Akop payam, Tonj North County（含Bundir村）
location.raw_text: Akop payam, Tonj North County, Greater Tonj, Warrap

key_facts.fact: 大通季地区族群间暴力再度爆发，导致家庭流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: As renewed intercommunal violence drives families from their homes across Greater Tonj

key_facts.fact: 冲突发生在瓦拉普州通季北县阿科普乡，此前多年存在紧张与报复性袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The latest outbreak of conflict in Akop payam, Tonj North County, follows years of tensions and retaliatory attacks between communities.

key_facts.fact: 民居被烧、生计受扰、家庭流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Homes have been burned, livelihoods disrupted and families displaced

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹特派团综合巡逻队访问阿科普及本迪尔村，与居民和地方当局会面
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an integrated UNMISS patrol team visited Akop, including Bundir village

key_facts.fact: 据救济与恢复委员会称，通季北县逾1.2万户家庭据报流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to the Relief and Rehabilitation Commission (RRC), more than 12,000 households have reportedly been displaced across Tonj North County

key_facts.fact: 救济与恢复委员会于10月28日发出紧急援助呼吁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In an urgent appeal issued on 28 October, the Commission called for emergency assistance

uncertainties: 流离失所家庭数字为据报数据，救济与恢复委员会呼吁人道伙伴核实
冲突具体伤亡情况未获确认
事件发生日期为2026年10月30日报道，冲突具体起始时间不明
